rules: Headings in Arabic must use Tajawal or Cairo with font-extrabold or font-bold.
English phonetic text or target vocabulary highlights must use monospace or bold Outfit font for clear separation.
Never use Inter for Arabic headlines.

rtl_rules: Root container must have dir='rtl' and lang='ar'.
Use logical Tailwind spacing utilities like ms-* (margin-inline-start) and me-* (margin-inline-end) instead of ml-* and mr-* where directionality matters.
Icons indicating direction (e.g. Next arrow, back arrow) must flip direction when in RTL.
Sidebar and navigation drawer must originate from the right side in RTL mode.
Flex containers with labels and badges must align correctly for RTL text flow.
spacing_and_layout.padding_philosophy: Containers with borders must carry generous inner padding (p-6 or p-8) to avoid collision with text.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0E1F38]/80 border border-white/10 shadow-2xl shadow-black/50

visual_enhancers.waveform_bar: Animated CSS canvas / SVG live audio pulse bar for active speech listening, tinted in brand teal.

testing_and_data_testid_rules.mandatory_rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a clear role-based data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Ensure root HTML has dir='rtl' and lang='ar' set by default.
2. Primary interface text must be in Arabic with high-quality educational tone, while target learning phrases and phonetics are in English.
3. Use Shadcn components for dialogs, tabs, progress bars, selects, and dropdowns, customized with dark navy (#0E1F38) backgrounds.
4. Ensure audio microphone recording has simulated or Web Speech API fallback with active dynamic wave visuals, tinted brand teal (#5FA8B2).
5. Include testids on all buttons, forms, audio toggles, and assessment cards.

6. Do not use bright cyan, emerald, or indigo brand colors. Use the logo palette only: Deep Navy (#081328) background with Teal (#5FA8B2) as the primary interactive color and Champagne Gold (#E3C88A) as the accent color, exactly as defined in colors.brand above.

7. This file (design_guidelines.json) is the single source of truth for the whole project, including the Admin dashboard. Never hardcode hex colors or font names directly in a page component — always reference the CSS variables / Tailwind tokens generated from this file.
